theme_description: AI chat theme for intelligent Q&A, document search, and automated replies

site_description.label: Site tagline
site_description.info: Shown below the site name in the sidebar

robot_name.label: Assistant name
robot_name.info: Displayed in AI chat and search

ai_search_completed_text.label: AI answer footer note
ai_search_completed_text.info: Appended to each AI answer. HTML links are supported.
ai_search_completed_text.default: If you need more help, please contact support.

kb_menu_label.label: Knowledge base menu label
kb_menu_label.info: Label for the knowledge base link in the sidebar

chat_delete_enabled.label: Allow deleting chats
chat_delete_enabled.info: When enabled, users can delete chat history from the Recent list in the sidebar

feedback_helper_text.label: Feedback survey JSON
feedback_helper_text.info: JSON with yes/no labels, titles, and item lists
feedback_helper_text.default: {"yes":{"label":"Yes","title":"Great! What worked best?","items":["The guide worked as expected.","I found what I needed easily.","The product was easy to understand.","The docs are up to date."]},"no":{"label":"No","title":"How can we improve?","items":["Help me get started faster.","Make it easier to find what I need.","Explain the product more clearly.","Update this document."]}}

left_sidebar_width.label: Left sidebar width
left_sidebar_width.info: Width of the main chat sidebar; ~280px recommended

header_height.label: Header height
header_height.info: Top bar height in pixels; affects sticky TOC positioning

show_list.label: Section page
show_list.info: Show child pages as a list; the home node always lists children

icon.label: Page icon
icon.info: Icon in child page lists; 1:1 ratio recommended

welcome_description.label: Welcome description
welcome_description.default: Ask a question and we'll search the knowledge base to find the most relevant answer.

popular_searches.label: Suggested questions
popular_searches.info: Shown on the home page and search modal; one question per line

chat_input_placeholder.label: Input placeholder
chat_input_placeholder.default: Type your question and press Enter…

chat_disclaimer.label: Disclaimer below input
chat_disclaimer.default: Answers are based on this knowledge base only; no external data is used.
